ConnectionStrings.//comment: EDIT: point Server= at your SQL host and Database= at the archive DB. Integrated Security uses the IIS App Pool identity (no password stored).

Archive.//AttachmentRoot: UNC path to the attachment store when running off-box; use the local F:\... path when running on the SQL host itself.

Access.//comment: AllowedGroupIds = all groups (granted to Full Access users). RhGroupIds granted to FS_Portal_RH_Access members; ItGroupIds to FS_Portal_IT_Access members. A user's visible groups = union across the tables they belong to; no membership = no access.
